outcome: Chronic hypertension with superimposed preeclampsia or eclampsia
cohort: The cohort comprised 86,615 pregnancies complicated by diabetes mellitus among women who delivered between 2004 and 2014, with 1,241 of these cases also having diabetic nephropathy.
finding: Diabetic nephropathy in pregnant women with diabetes mellitus is strongly associated with increased risks of preeclampsia, chronic hypertension with superimposed preeclampsia or eclampsia, preterm birth, and blood transfusion, leading to higher obstetrical and perinatal morbidity.
